text: All right, we need the AI dashboard to be able to prompt me. And a new prompt is current. It goes to the top of the list. The card preview on the left, if we have something selected, we probably want to add the card to the timeline. Maybe I think we'll want a title bar, a toolbar for maybe both columns, maybe independently for each column, to configure the view. But what I'm thinking is that a new item, kind of an alert or something, could appear at the top of the list. We don't want to rescroll. If the user has scrolled down in the list and has one currently selected, we don't want to jank their UI around. However, when a new item comes in, we want a little button that pops up that notifies them and says new item, or something. And maybe spacebar. Spacebar could be like an okay, show me the current thing. I think that's how StarCraft works. And when you hit spacebar, boom, it scrolls you to the top of the list, selects the new item, and you could put UI controls into those items, like ask a question, yes, no, or whatever.
